scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/bootstrap-env.mjs && node scripts/check-env.mjs
scripts.setup:newsletter: npm run check-env && npm run db:newsletter
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['.next','.open-next']) { try { fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); } catch {} } console.log('clean: removed .next/.open-next');"
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.deploy:clean: npm run clean && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.wsl:test: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wsl-run.ps1 -Command "npm install && npm run test"
scripts.wsl:build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wsl-run.ps1 -Command "npm install && npm run build:clean"
scripts.wsl:deploy: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wsl-run.ps1 -Command "npm install && npm run deploy:clean"
